title: SPECIAL OPERATION: PINCH-OUT EXPERIMENTAL OPERATION OPEN
lines: 01 SPECIAL OPERATION: PINCH-OUT EXPERIMENTAL OPERATION OPEN
EVENT STAGE DURATION: December 5, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 19, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 3-8

DETAILS: During the event, players can combat in the Test Site using different "test criteria." By completing tests, players can increase their Sanctuary Judgment scores and collect "Crystalized Originium" (which can be used to exchange for rewards in the Crystallization Sanctuary). Upon completing certain "test criteria," players can also earn rewards such as the [Bloodline of Combat-Justice Knight-Tournament Fantasy Retrofit Kit] outfit, the event operator [★: Friston-3], and Integrated Module Data Chunks.
[Crystallization Sanctuary]
DURATION: December 5, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – December 22, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Crystalized Originium. Crystalized Originium can be used to redeem items in Crystallization Sanctuary.
MAIN REWARDS: Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
Please stay tuned for further information.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DURATION: December 5, 2023, 10:00 – December 19, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Saga / Mountain / Goldenglow / Mudrock
★★★★★: Proviso / Firewhistle / Ashlock / Kirara / Aosta / Kafka
03 OPERATORS UPDATE IN RECRUITMENT
UPDATE TIME: December 5, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: After the update, the following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment.
★ Friston-3
Note:
During this update, tags that have not yet been used for recruitment will be refreshed. Please stay tuned for further information.
